appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4'.
A single blue line connects four points, one per quarter, rising from Q1 to Q2, holding level from Q2 to Q3, and rising again from Q3 to Q4.
The Q1 point is the lowest on the series; the Q4 point is the highest; Q2 and Q3 sit at the same mid-level between them.

printed_facts.fact: Vertical axis is labeled 'Revenue' with ticks at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1,000, 1,200, 1,400, 1,600.
Horizontal axis is labeled 'Quarter' with category ticks Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 in left-to-right order.
Header text states 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4'.
